## Specific task description

Task instruction: Set the phone with rounded edges on the brown angled plastic phonestand.

Task description: Place the rounded phone at the front left of the table on the slanted brown plastic phone stand toward the back center, so the stand supports it.

Success criteria: The phone is placed near the stand’s support area, close to it in left-right, front-back, and height; both grippers are open and have released the phone.

## Execution tips

- Grip the straight middle sections of the phone's two long edges, avoiding rounded corners, and leave support space at the end that will face downward during placement. Open slightly wider than the phone; before closing, ensure both finger pads contact the thickness of the side edges rather than merely pressing the top surface or hitting the table.
- Adjust the phone tilt where surrounding clearance allows, approaching with its back along the stand's inclined support surface. Watch finger-to-stand clearance to reduce sweeping collisions during adjustment.
- Support the phone's lower edge and rest its back against the support surface. Release only when it no longer depends on the grasp, avoiding edge-only support and slipping. Leave fingertip clearance on withdrawal to reduce dragging the phone off the stand.
